sun.definition: per hour: mean over the samples of max(0, cos(angle sun - surface normal of the sample)) where the sun stands above the own horizon of the sample in its direction (horizon linear in azimuth), else 0; normal from the A1 gradient of the sample cell
sun.encoding: 288 bytes, c x 255 rounded, base64; index = 24 * (month - 1) + hour, months first
sun.time: UTC, the middle of each hour (hh:30); solar position at the longitude and latitude of each sample (the own longitude of the glacier), cosZenith of meltcore.mjs (Spencer 1971)
sun.sunDay: per month: sum of c over the day / sum of the flat cos zenith over the hours with the sun above 0 deg (free horizon), two decimals

svf.formula: mean over the 24 directions of cos^2(max(horizon, 0)), mean over the samples
svf.source: sky-view factor of a horizontal surface, Dozier & Frew (1990), IEEE TGRS 28(5)
